visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a long white rectangular plate covered in thinly sliced raw red lamb. The hand slowly flips the plate vertically to demonstrate that the meat adheres to the surface without falling. (2) A person with short dark hair walks into a restaurant under a white banner with black calligraphy. Inside, a man wearing a green military-style shirt and a black baseball cap speaks toward the camera while gesturing with his hands. (3) A close-up shows pieces of lamb meat being grilled on a wire mesh over glowing charcoal, with small flames rising. (4) A metal ladle lifts a portion of pinkish lamb from a boiling pot of soup containing white tofu and yellow pickled cabbage. (5) A table is filled with various white plates of raw lamb, side dishes, and a stainless steel pot on a portable stove. (6) A series of close-ups feature different cuts of lamb on white plates, accompanied by small black identification labels. (7) Silver chopsticks pick up a piece of cooked meat and dip it into a small black dish of red chili sauce. (8) A plate of golden-brown caramelized bread cubes dusted with white sugar is shown. (9) The camera pans across a clean dining table with black placemats and then shows the restaurant's exterior sign at night with glowing lanterns.

(6) [Subtitle]: 這裡的羊肉可以炭火烤 也能下鍋涮. (7) [Subtitle]: 有超過十種不同部位 我們最喜歡嫩肩肉. (8) [Subtitle]: 軟Q多汁又香甜 也能沾香辣醬享用. (9) [Subtitle]: 還有帶淡淡奶香的橫隔膜. (10) [Subtitle]: 肋眼的肉香比較濃郁. (11) [Subtitle]: 羊板腱帶筋有腳勁.
